title: Fergus Golf Club rezoning and subdivision approved
subtitle: Farm surplus dwelling rezoning, Elora downtown grant, hospital farmhouse lease, excess soil roster and Pilkington bridges study
overview: Council approved the rezoning of the Fergus Golf Club lands and told the County of Wellington it supports draft approval of the related subdivision and condominium plans, subject to conditions in the planning report {{vote:m3}}. The developer's representative said the company is committed to a well monitoring program and a municipal responsibility agreement, and has agreed to a tree buffer and chain link fence next to active farms.

Council also approved a rezoning for a farm surplus dwelling at 8252 Sideroad 30, Eramosa {{vote:m4}}, a $10,000 façade and property improvement grant for 27-43 West Mill St. in Elora {{vote:m5}}, and a lease allowing Groves Memorial Community Hospital to use the Gartshore Street farmhouse in Fergus for healthcare professional recruitment {{vote:m6}}.

Council approved a roster of nine firms to act as Qualified Persons for excess soil work {{vote:m7}} and received a report launching an environmental assessment of five bridges in the former Pilkington Township {{vote:m2}}. Zoning and lease by-laws were passed {{vote:m8}}. The Mayor also reported that the Grand River Conservation Authority is adjusting to new provincial regulations and will update local councils.

decisions.item: Fergus Golf Club rezoning and subdivision
decisions.detail: Council approved rezoning application RZ06/22 and supported draft approval of the subdivision and condominium plans, subject to conditions in the staff report.
Council approved rezoning application RZ004/23 for the Eramosa property, related to a farm surplus dwelling.

Council approved a $10,000 Level Two Façade, Building and Property Improvement Grant for 27-43 West Mill St. and delegated agreement signing to the Managing Director of Corporate Services and Treasurer.
Council authorized the Mayor and Clerk to sign a lease with Groves Memorial Community Hospital for 965 Gartshore Street for healthcare professional recruitment.
Council approved nine vendors for a roster providing Qualified Person services under Ontario Regulation 406/19.
Council received for information the notice of commencement of a Municipal Class Environmental Assessment for five bridges in the former Pilkington Township.
